- **Built:** `src/obs/summary.ts` exports `SpanNode` and `summariseTrace`. - **Tests:** `tests/obs-summary.test.ts` passes (3 tests, 10 assertions). `bun run typecheck` printed no errors.
- **Full suite:** my first run of `bun test` hit the command timeout. Other agents are running tests in parallel and some of the suite's tests fetch over the network, so it is slow. I started it again in the background and it hasn't reported yet.
